question: What can Taiwan ETF units/PCF data identify about primary-market fund-size change and basket obligations without falsely claiming same-day constituent executions?

primaryFlowObject.name: reportedOutstandingUnitChangeWithOperationalAdjustments
primaryFlowObject.interpretation: Reported ETF unit change after acknowledging initial-review success, second-review failure reversals and dual-currency conversions where applicable.

taiwanExecutionIdentifiabilityGuards.existingInventory: Applicants/APs may deliver pre-existing holdings; creation need not cause new market purchases.
taiwanExecutionIdentifiabilityGuards.collectiveInKindCreation: Up to three applicants may pool existing holdings for an in-kind creation.
taiwanExecutionIdentifiabilityGuards.minimumInKindBasket: With issuer approval, an AP may initially deliver at least 90% of the required stock-basket market value and later buy or borrow shortage shares by the next business day.
taiwanExecutionIdentifiabilityGuards.cashSubstitution: Specific PCF constituents may be replaced by cash under allowed conditions.
taiwanExecutionIdentifiabilityGuards.pcfVersioning: T-day PCF can be updated/retransmitted; same-generation version/use-date/hash must be preserved.
taiwanExecutionIdentifiabilityGuards.conclusion: Units delta plus PCF can support MODELED_PRIMARY_BASKET_EXPOSURE, not ACTUAL_STOCK_PASSIVE_FLOW.

crossModuleOwnership.D11_14: index event identity, announcement/effective clocks and event lifecycle
crossModuleOwnership.D06_16: creation/redemption, AP, premium-discount, tracking and underlying-liquidity mechanics
crossModuleOwnership.antiDoubleCount: One event/units primitive receipt is referenced downstream; it does not create multiple directional votes.

falsification: Zero units delta does not prove zero gross creation/redemption.
Positive units delta does not prove every constituent was bought in the secondary market that day.
In-kind creation can be sourced from existing inventory, pooled applicants, partial baskets, later purchases or borrowed shortage shares.
Cash substitution breaks one-to-one physical basket delivery.
Premium/discount creates an arbitrage opportunity but does not prove immediate full constituent execution.
Current interfaces prove prospective feasibility, not immutable historical first-known truth.
exactNext: PF-040 remains reserved for the next genuine independent trading-day units-delta+PCF prospective receipt. Preserve same-generation PCF and execution-uncertainty fields; do not backfill weekend/current pages into historical firstKnownAt.
